items.title: Robot Finger Feels in Color
items.titleCn: 机器人 Finger Feels in Color
items.summary: Imagine running your fingertip over the surface of a U.S. penny. You would feel the ridges of the raised letters and numbers, Abe Lincoln’s bearded side profile, and, if it’s tails, the fluted columns...
